entities.summary: Sarhan Guliev is an Azerbaijani chess player who holds the title of Grandmaster (GM). He earned the International Master (IM) title in 1993 and the Grandmaster title in 1995. He was a member of the Azerbaijan Chess Olympiad team in 1994 and 1998.
